# NewHomeSource

> > The leading marketplace for searching 12,000+ new home communities, connecting homebuyers with builders, floor plans, and pricing across major U.S. markets.

NewHomeSource is a comprehensive real estate marketplace specializing in new construction homes and builder communities. The platform aggregates listings from top builders like Pulte Homes and Centex Homes across key markets including Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Atlanta, and Las Vegas, providing homebuyers with search tools, pricing information, and builder reviews.

- [New Homes Search & Home Builders](https://auth.newhomesource.com/): Search 12,000+ new home communities with pricing, floor plans, and builder reviews
